A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same readable, 24-page SciLitLLM paper, including Appendices A-H. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish identical research content; the only visible difference is the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v4 reports original SciLitLLM benchmark and ablation results in Tables 2-6, plus filtering sensitivity, contamination analysis, and human evaluation in Appendices C, G, and H.

after.justification: v5 retains these original experiments and appendix analyses. Table 3 explicitly distinguishes borrowed comparator results from results produced by the authors.

M1.justification: Section 2 and Appendices B-D retain the identical Qwen2.5-based CPT/SFT pipeline, text correction, quality filtering, instruction synthesis, and deduplication procedures.

E1.justification: Training sources in Table 1 and task coverage in Section 3.1 and Appendix E are unchanged. Both evaluate the same MMLU-Pro subjects, MaScQA, SciAssess, and SciRIFF tasks.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain identical comparator membership, including Llama3.1, Qwen2.5, Mistral-7B, SciTulu-7B, GPT-3.5, and GPT-4o in Tables 2, 3, and 8.

E3.justification: Model sizes, training budgets, preprocessing, evaluation metrics, and testing procedures are unchanged. The benchmark evaluation details and contamination and human-evaluation protocols in Appendices E, G, and H also match.

E4.justification: Both retain the CPT, SFT-data, and instruction-filter ablations in Tables 4-6, filtering-threshold sensitivity in Table 7, contamination analysis in Appendix G, and human validation in Appendix H.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical, including the Spearman-based agreement calculations in Appendix H. Neither version adds repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings match, including appendix Tables 7-11. For example, Table 3 retains SciLitLLM-7B means of 51.7 on SciAssess and 60.6 on SciRIFF in both versions.

T1.justification: The mathematical content, including the Levenshtein-based similarity definition in Appendix D.2, is identical. No formal assumptions, definitions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about CPT/SFT domain adaptation, the SciLitIns contribution, benchmark advantages, and applicability to other specialized domains.

C2.justification: Performance explanations and appendix interpretations are unchanged. Section 4 retains the same limitations concerning data volume, reasoning enhancement, and preference alignment.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, training times, prompts, and processing instructions match throughout Section 2 and the appendices. Code and model access disclosures and link targets are also unchanged.

R1.justification: The reference list, citations, and related-work discussion in Appendix A are identical. No cited works or substantive claims about the relationship to prior research change.

P1.justification: Only the marginal arXiv stamp changes from v4, 23 Feb 2025 to v5, 18 Apr 2025. The title, authors, prose, terminology, section ordering, and appendix structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1-7, Tables 1-11, captions, and page layouts are unchanged. Pages 2-24 render identically, and the first-page visual difference is confined to the version/date text.

improvement.justification: v5 changes only the arXiv version/date stamp. The methods, empirical evidence, explanations, limitations, reproducibility information, and substantive presentation remain identical across the main text and appendices, establishing no meaningful difference in overall quality.
